transcript: On my way home, I was walking through the town Though I was tired, my steps felt light Passing through a narrow alley and crossing a small plaza I felt the atmosphere of the town The street lamps cast gentle shadows And I walked on, leaving the butcher's shop behind I saw the bakery sign glowing, a rich scent drifted out And my mood began to improve Near home I happened upon an old friend Seeing me he waved and laughed The encounter was an unexpected joy Exchanging a few words with him I felt the day's tiredness vanish completely Walking through the town I felt the small delights of daily life quietly embrace me

segments.text: On my way home, I was walking through the town
Though I was tired, my steps felt light
Passing through a narrow alley and crossing a small plaza
I felt the atmosphere of the town
The street lamps cast gentle shadows
And I walked on, leaving the butcher's shop behind
I saw the bakery sign glowing, a rich scent drifted out
And my mood began to improve
Near home I happened upon an old friend
Seeing me he waved and laughed
The encounter was an unexpected joy
Exchanging a few words with him
I felt the day's tiredness vanish completely
I felt the small delights of daily life quietly embrace me
